records.beforeArg: resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' | extend addressSpace = todynamic(properties.addressSpace) | extend addressPrefix = todynamic(properties.addressSpace.addressPrefixes) | mvexpand addressSpace | mvexpand addressPrefix | project name, id, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, cidr = addressPrefix | extend compliant = (cidr matches regex @'^(10\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.|192\\.168\\.)')  | project id, compliant, cidr
records.afterArg: resources | where type == 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' | extend addressSpace = todynamic(properties.addressSpace) | extend addressPrefix = todynamic(properties.addressSpace.addressPrefixes) | mvexpand addressSpace | mvexpand addressPrefix | project name, id, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, cidr = addressPrefix | extend compliant = (cidr matches regex @'^(10\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\\.|192\\.168\\.)')  | project id, compliant, cidr

records.title: Don't enable virtual network service endpoints by default on all subnets.
records.reason: No service endpoints is not universally compliant: applicability depends on an approved service/network design. Existing endpoints require intent-based review.
records.beforeArg: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' | project id,resourceGroup,name,subnets = properties.subnets | mv-expand subnets | project id = subnets.id, resourceGroup, VNet = name, serviceEndpoints = subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints, compliant = (isnull(subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints) or array_length(subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints) == 0) | order by compliant asc
records.afterArg: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/virtualnetworks' | project id,resourceGroup,name,subnets = properties.subnets | mv-expand subnets | project id = subnets.id, resourceGroup, VNet = name, serviceEndpoints = subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints, compliant = (isnull(subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints) or array_length(subnets.properties.serviceEndpoints) == 0) | order by compliant asc

records.title: For outbound Internet traffic protection and filtering, deploy Azure Firewall in secured hubs
records.reason: A non-null azureFirewall reference does not prove a secured hub's effective routing, firewall attachment or egress enforcement.
records.beforeArg: resources | where type=='microsoft.network/virtualhubs' | extend compliant = isnotnull(properties.azureFirewall.id) | project id, compliant
records.afterArg: resources | where type=='microsoft.network/virtualhubs' | extend compliant = isnotnull(properties.azureFirewall.id) | project id, compliant

records.title: Use HTTPS only
records.reason: The kind filter excludes other App Service kinds/slots; the inherited expression lacks an explicit table and httpsOnly is a redirect indicator, not full TLS validation.
records.beforeArg: where (type=='microsoft.web/sites' and (kind == 'app' or kind == 'app,linux' )) | extend compliant = (properties.httpsOnly==true) | distinct id,compliant
records.afterArg: where (type=='microsoft.web/sites' and (kind == 'app' or kind == 'app,linux' )) | extend compliant = (properties.httpsOnly==true) | distinct id,compliant
